decision_basis: Exact endothelial THY1-alphaMbeta2/Mac-1 adhesion and transendothelial-migration function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve the complete Mac-1 heterodimer and no cytosolic relay or TF claim.
Exact TIMP1-CD63/beta1-integrin tetraspanin-complex relay/function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve beta1-integrin, cancer-state, and domain context and do not call CD63 a kinase receptor.

Exact TIMP2-alpha3beta1/SHP-1-Csk/cAMP-Rap1-MAPK inhibitory relay/function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve the complete alpha3beta1 complex and distinguish integrin outputs from FGF2/VEGF antagonism.
Exact TIMP2-alpha3beta1/ITGB1 complex function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve ITGB1 as the beta1 subunit, not an isolated receptor, and retain the SHP-1/Csk/cAMP-Rap1/MAPK context.

Exact TNC FNIII-domain-CNTN1/contactin binding and neuronal adhesion/neurite function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve TNC splice/domain architecture and no CNTN1 cytosolic relay or TF claim.
Exact TNC FNIII-D alpha7beta1 binding and neuronal process-extension function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve the complete alpha7beta1 heterodimer and no isolated ITGA7 relay or TF claim.

Exact transferrin-TFR2alpha binding, uptake/recycling, and iron-sensing function supports qualified-high promotion; preserve lower affinity versus TFR1, TFR2 isoform/tissue context, and scavenging-only topology.
